full_name: Ann Fessler | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Ann Fessler, a visual artist and professor at Rhode Island School of Design, has worked over the past twenty years in interactive-video and sound installations, photography, and artists’ books, using storytelling to explore issues of family, identity, and gender inequities.
